scenes.title: Home And Platform Intro
scenes.action: Scroll slowly through hero and headline sections.
scenes.narration: Welcome to NGO Connect. This platform connects donors, volunteers, NGOs, and admins in one transparent social impact ecosystem.

scenes.title: User Login
scenes.narration: First, we enter as a user. Users can discover trusted NGOs, donate securely, volunteer in campaigns, and track their impact in one place.

scenes.title: Discover NGOs
scenes.action: Use search and category filters, then open one NGO card.
scenes.narration: The discovery module helps users filter NGOs by cause, location, and relevance so support decisions are faster and better informed.

scenes.title: Map View
scenes.action: Pan map and show directions option.
scenes.narration: The map view adds geographic context, allowing users to explore nearby NGOs and plan location-aware support and volunteering.

scenes.title: Campaign Listing
scenes.action: Open a campaign and show progress area.
scenes.narration: Campaign pages show goals, current progress, beneficiary outcomes, and updates, helping users evaluate where contributions create the most impact.

scenes.title: Donation Flow
scenes.action: Show payment method options and amount entry.
scenes.narration: The donation flow supports UPI, card, and netbanking through a structured initiate and confirm workflow designed for reliability and traceability.

scenes.title: Volunteer Opportunities
scenes.action: Open one opportunity and show apply section.
scenes.narration: Users can browse volunteer opportunities, apply directly, and contribute through skills, time, and on-ground support, not only donations.

scenes.title: User Dashboard And Profile
scenes.action: Show dashboard stats, then move to /profile.
scenes.narration: Dashboards and profiles summarize each user journey, including donation records, volunteer activity, certificates, and overall contribution tracking.

scenes.title: Messages Insights Recommendations
scenes.narration: Engagement features include direct messaging, smart insights, personalized recommendations, and an AI chatbot to guide users across platform workflows.

scenes.title: Innovation Center
scenes.action: Scroll through emergency feed, giving circles, wishlist, leaderboard, and endorsements.
scenes.narration: Innovation Center expands participation through emergency response feeds, giving circles, in-kind wishlists, gamification, endorsements, and corporate matching workflows.

scenes.title: Switch To NGO Role
scenes.narration: Now we switch to the NGO role to see how organizations run campaigns, operations, supporter engagement, and internal coordination.

scenes.title: NGO Operations
scenes.action: Show NGO profile management, then open /campaigns/create and one existing campaign.
scenes.narration: NGOs can manage profile data, publish campaigns, review volunteering and donation activity, and maintain execution quality through structured workflows.

scenes.title: Campaign Updates And Analytics
scenes.action: Open a campaign and show update posting or campaign analytics panels.
scenes.narration: Campaign update tools help NGOs publish delivery milestones and track supporter engagement, improving transparency and long-term donor trust.

scenes.title: Switch To Admin Role
scenes.narration: Now we move to admin controls where governance, moderation, and platform-level reliability are managed centrally.

scenes.title: Admin Governance
scenes.narration: Admins verify NGOs, moderate flagged content, monitor analytics, manage requests, and maintain healthy platform operations across all stakeholder groups.

scenes.title: Reliability And Architecture Close
scenes.action: Show admin dashboard metrics and close on home page.
scenes.narration: Behind the interface, NGO Connect runs on a React frontend, Express API, and PostgreSQL data model with webhook reliability, replay operations, and measurable delivery observability.
